reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for connecting to NebulaGraph v5, executing ISO-GQL, inspecting graph schemas, returning structured results, and rendering graph data interactively.

summaries.zh: 连接 NebulaGraph v5 服务器，执行 ISO-GQL 查询、查看图 schema，并以表格和交互式图形展示结果。
summaries.en: Connect to NebulaGraph v5 servers to execute ISO-GQL, inspect graph schemas, and display results as tables and interactive graphs.

capabilities: Connects to and authenticates with NebulaGraph v5 servers
Executes user-supplied ISO-GQL statements that may modify graph data
Reads graph schemas and query results
Stores and resolves connection credentials through configured references
Renders graph query results interactively in the web client
